message:
Partial refunds now come out right. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by `percent`, which is 0–100, so a 50% refund came out 50 times too large. It now divides by 100 before rounding.

`npm test` passes, all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
